about: The parts a custom block's layout is built from (board.block.define). A layout is data only: a tree of these parts, each bound to the block's props. Toru draws every part with its own UI SDK components; no markup, script or style from a definition is ever run. Go (internal/board/blockdef.go) and the board window (frontend/src/whiteboard/custom-blocks.tsx) both read this file.

fieldKinds.text: Plain text shown as is, up to 200 characters.
fieldKinds.template: Plain text up to 500 characters; {name} is replaced by the value of the block's text, number or true/false prop called name.
fieldKinds.prop: The name of one of the block's top-level props. Each part says which kinds of prop it takes.
fieldKinds.color: One of the board colours: yellow, pink, blue, green, purple, orange, grey.
fieldKinds.colors: An object from a prop's enum values to board colours, like {"high": "pink"}.
fieldKinds.icon: One of the icon names listed under icons.
fieldKinds.columns: A list of 1 to 12 column names, up to 60 characters each.

stack.description: Lays its children out in a column (default) or a row. With tone it becomes a tinted panel.

text.description: A line or paragraph of text.

badge.description: A small coloured label. With prop, it shows that prop's value and takes its colour from colors.

field.description: Editable text bound to a text prop: one line, or several with multiline.

checkbox.description: A checkbox bound to a true/false prop.

choice.description: Pick one of a text prop's enum values, as radio buttons or a segmented row.

counter.description: A whole number with a button that adds one, like votes. Shows the number beside the button.

slider.description: A slider bound to a number prop. min and max come from the prop's schema unless given.

rating.description: Stars bound to a whole-number prop.

progress.description: A bar showing a number prop out of max (default the prop's maximum, or 100).

checklist.description: A list of items to tick, bound to a list of {text, done}. People and agents add, tick and remove items.

list.description: A bulleted list bound to a list of text. People and agents add and remove items.

tags.description: Tags bound to a list of text, typed with commas.

poll.description: Vote for options, bound to a list of {label, votes}.

table.description: A table with fixed columns, bound to a list of rows (each a list of text). People and agents edit cells and add rows.

image.description: A board picture, bound to a text prop holding a picture's asset name (from board.image.import). Empty shows a plain frame.
